subject: Human Evolution
title: Genetic Drift
description: A fast breakdown of Genetic Drift for builders.

hook.text: Not all evolution is survival of the fittest. Random chance can change gene frequencies in small populations.

buildup.text: In a tiny group, a gene variant can vanish or dominate purely by luck—who happened to have children.

discovery.text: This is genetic drift: random fluctuation that's strongest when populations are small.

twist.text: Founder effects amplify drift. When a small group settles new territory, their genes dominate the population.

climax.text: Many human genetic patterns reflect drift during ancient population bottlenecks, not adaptive selection.

punchline.text: Sometimes evolution is just luck, not fitness.

quiz.question: What is genetic drift?
options: Random changes in gene frequency, strongest in small populations
